The Dataproc Metastore API is used to manage the lifecycle and
configuration of metastore services.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `DataprocMetastoreClient`: Configures and manages metastore services. (Recommended starting point)
- `DataprocMetastoreFederationClient`: Configures and manages metastore federation services.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `DataprocMetastoreClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudMetastoreV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudMetastoreV1.DataprocMetastoreClient()
  let items = client.listServicesByItems(
    request: ListServicesRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Requirements

For the minimum supported Swift version and platform requirements, see the
[Requirements](https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-swift#minimum-supported-swift-version)

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-metastore-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-metastore-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudMetastoreV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudMetastoreV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-metastore-v1
```
